title: Align Engine Mcp App Styling with Semio Ui
description: The MCP app in semio/engine has standalone styling that diverges from semio/ui. It must use identical styling (colors, sizes, fonts, etc.) and remove any debug code. Need to compare the MCP app TSX with the semio/ui diagram components and align them.
summary:
Aligned engine MCP app styling with semio/ui theme system and removed all debug code. Changes:

1. **SemioDiagram component**: Removed debug overlay div (bottom-right with monospace stats), green SVG background (`rgba(0,128,0,0.1)`), and red debug circle+text diagnostic elements.

2. **McpDesignViewer**: Removed `_dbg*` debug variables and debug overlay div (top-left with split view stats). Replaced all hardcoded color fallbacks (`#ffffff`, `#737373`, `#dc2626`) with semio theme variables (`var(--base)`, `var(--muted-foreground)`, `var(--destructive-foreground)`).

3. **McpKitViewer**: Replaced hardcoded colors (`#1e1e1e`, `#e5e5e5`, `#a3a3a3`, `#f87171`, `#fafafa`) with theme variables (`var(--base)`, `var(--foreground)`, `var(--muted-foreground)`, `var(--destructive-foreground)`). Removed inline comment about fixed fallbacks.

4. **McpSceneViewer**: Replaced `var(--color-background-primary, #ffffff)`, `var(--color-text-danger, #dc2626)`, `var(--color-text-secondary, #737373)` with `var(--base)`, `var(--destructive-foreground)`, `var(--muted-foreground)`.

5. **McpDiagramViewer**: Same shell style unification as McpSceneViewer.

6. **buildScenePieceAssets**: Removed 3 `console.debug` calls and unused `withModel` variable.

7. **mcpFlattenDesignForSemioSurface**: Removed 4 `console.debug` calls and unused counting variables.

8. **mcp-app.tsx crash fallback**: Updated to use theme variables with hardcoded fallbacks for pre-mount crash scenario.

9. Rebuilt `dist/mcp-app.html` (7MB, 3.3MB gzip) with all changes incorporated.

All 177 engine Python tests pass. semio/ui 218/220 tests pass (2 pre-existing failures in scene color tokens unrelated to this change).
